answer: The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. Each collapsed cluster gets one falcon weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The beacon report makes public the merge explicitly at each pigment. A 427 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
